9. B001-9: 1 Corinthians 6:16 / Genesis 2:24
Status: TEXT_PRESENT
1
.
Exact Passage / Reference: ΓΕΝΕΣΙΣ (Genesis) 2:24
1
.
Exact Printed Text Needed for Comparison:
ἕνεκεν τούτου καταλείψει ἄνθρωπος τὸν πατέρα αὐτοῦ καὶ τὴν μητέρα αὐτοῦ, καὶ προσκολληθήσεται τῇ γυναικὶ αὐτοῦ· καὶ ἔσονται οἱ δύο εἰς σάρκα μίαν.
1
Printed Page / Locator: Page 4
1
.
Whether an Apparatus Entry Occurs at the Target Wording: YES (at the verse level for the preceding clause, but NO for the specific quotation clause)
1
.
Exact Apparatus Information:
24 τη γυναικι] προς την γυναικα DE
1
What the Apparatus Entry Does and Does Not Establish:
Does establish: A prepositional variant in the second clause of verse 24, where Codex Alexandrinus (A, the base text printed on this page) reads the dative τῇ γυναικὶ αὐτοῦ, while Codex Cottonianus (D) and Codex Bodleianus (E) read the prepositional phrase πρὸς τὴν γυναῖκα
1
2
. It also establishes that the final clause (καὶ ἔσονται οἱ δύο εἰς σάρκα μίαν)—the exact words quoted in 1 Corinthians 6:16—is attested without variation across all collated uncials (A, D, E)
1
2
.
Does not establish: Any Greek textual variation in the target citation clause, nor any evidence from Codex Vaticanus (B), which has a known lacuna spanning Genesis 1:1–46:28
1
3
.
10. B001-10: 1 Corinthians 9:9 / Deuteronomy 25:4
Status: TEXT_PRESENT
4
.
Exact Passage / Reference: ΔΕΥΤΕΡΟΝΟΜΙΟΝ (Deuteronomy) 25:4
4
.
Exact Printed Text Needed for Comparison:
Οὐ φιμώσεις βοῦν ἀλοῶντα.
4
Printed Page / Locator: Page 392
4
.
Whether an Apparatus Entry Occurs at the Target Wording: NO
4
.
Exact Apparatus Information: None
4
. The apparatus at the foot of page 392 records variants for Deuteronomy 24:15–21 and 25:1, 2, 3, 5, containing no entry for 25:4
4
.
What the Apparatus Entry Does and Does Not Establish:
Does establish: Unanimous agreement among the primary uncial witnesses collated for Deuteronomy—Codex Vaticanus (B, the volume's base text), Codex Alexandrinus (A), and Codex Ambrosianus (F)—for the reading Οὐ φιμώσεις βοῦν ἀλοῶντα
2
4
.
Does not establish: Any uncial Greek manuscript support for the variant verb form κημώσεις, which is printed in modern critical editions of 1 Corinthians 9:9
4
.
11. B001-11: 1 Corinthians 10:7 / Exodus 32:6
Status: TEXT_PRESENT
5
.
Exact Passage / Reference: ΕΞΟΔΟΣ (Exodus) 32:6
5
.
Exact Printed Text Needed for Comparison:
καὶ ὀρθρίσας τῇ ἐπαύριον ἀνεβίβασεν ὁλοκαυτώματα, καὶ προσήνεγκεν θυσίαν σωτηρίου· καὶ ἐκάθισεν ὁ λαὸς φαγεῖν καὶ πιεῖν, καὶ ἀνέστησαν παίζειν.
5
 (Target quotation clause: καὶ ἐκάθισεν ὁ λαὸς φαγεῖν καὶ πιεῖν, καὶ ἀνέστησαν παίζειν)
5
.
Printed Page / Locator: Page 169
5
.
Whether an Apparatus Entry Occurs at the Target Wording: YES
5
.
Exact Apparatus Information:
5–6 plurima mutila in F
5

6 ορθρισας] + ο.....F* (om ο F?) | θυ... F | πειν B* (πιειν Bab A)
5
What the Apparatus Entry Does and Does Not Establish:
Does establish: An itacistic orthographical variant on the infinitive within the narrative quotation clause, where the first hand of Codex Vaticanus (B
∗
) wrote πειν, while the corrector hand B
ab
 and Codex Alexandrinus (A) read πιειν
5
. It also records that Codex Ambrosianus (F) is largely mutilated in verses 5–6
5
.
Does not establish: Any lexical or syntactical divergence in the narrative clause (καὶ ἐκάθισεν ὁ λαὸς φαγεῖν καὶ πιεῖν, καὶ ἀνέστησαν παίζειν), confirming that the uncial Greek text matches the New Testament citation formula and wording
5
.
12. B001-12: Galatians 3:13 / Deuteronomy 21:23
Status: TEXT_PRESENT
6
.
Exact Passage / Reference: ΔΕΥΤΕΡΟΝΟΜΙΟΝ (Deuteronomy) 21:23
6
.
Exact Printed Text Needed for Comparison:
οὐ κοιμηθήσεται τὸ σῶμα αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τοῦ ξύλου, ἀλλὰ ταφῇ θάψετε αὐτὸ ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ, ὅτι κεκαταραμένος ὑπὸ θεοῦ πᾶς κρεμάμενος ἐπὶ ξύλου· καὶ οὐ μιανεῖτε τὴν γῆν ἣν Κύριος ὁ θεός σου δίδωσίν σοι ἐν κλήρῳ.
6

(Target quotation clause: ὅτι κεκαταραμένος ὑπὸ θεοῦ πᾶς κρεμάμενος ἐπὶ ξύλου)
6
.
Printed Page / Locator: Page 386
6
.
Whether an Apparatus Entry Occurs at the Target Wording: YES
6
.
Exact Apparatus Information:
23 ου κοιμ.] ουκ επικοιμ. AF | αυτο] αυτον AF | κεκατηραμενος AF | ου 2°] + μη AF | μιανειτε] μιανειται A μιανηται F
6
What the Apparatus Entry Does and Does Not Establish:
Does establish:
A phonological/orthographical variant on the participle, where Codex Vaticanus (B) prints κεκαταραμένος, while Codex Alexandrinus (A) and Codex Ambrosianus (F) read κεκατηραμενος
2
6
.
Crucially, that all extant uncial witnesses collated (B, A, and F) unanimously include the agentive phrase ὑπὸ θεοῦ ("by God")
2
6
.
Does not establish: Any Greek manuscript support among the primary uncials for omitting ὑπὸ θεοῦ, nor any witness reading the adjective ἐπικατάρατος in place of the participle form
6
.
Would you like to examine the uncial variants for any other Pentateuchal citations in Paul, such as Genesis 12:3 or Deuteronomy 32:35?
